newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold buys Mali mine from BHP.
newsitem.headline: Randgold buys Mali mine from BHP.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said on Tuesday its exploration and new business arm Randgold Resources had bought BHP Minerals Mali Inc from BHP Holdings Inc.

The structure of the deal enables Randgold to acquire BHP Minerals Mali for $30 million cash, a $23 million loan claim and a $31 million loan to be retained by BHP and paid back over six years, Randgold said in a statement.
Randgold would support the funding by raising $40 million through the issue of convertible debentures and capitalising $30 million of the proceeds into Randgold Resources.
Part of the $23 million loan claim was convertible into shares in Randgold Resources by agreement between BHP and Randgold.
The deal includes a 65 percent stake in Syama, one of West Africa's largest gold mines. Its estimated resources amount to 110,000 kg of gold at an in situ grade of 4.1 grams/tonne.

Randgold Resources chief executive Mark Bristow said the acquisition would lift the division into "a new league, adding a major gold producer to its existing portfolio of prime exploration properties in sub-Saharan Africa, and expanding its resource base to five million ounces of gold".
Randgold said the division was now poised for its proposed listing on major stock exchanges in the near future.
